Cheat Sheet

Quick reference for Claude Code

Start / Navigate
Start interactive sessionclaude
One-off taskclaude "task description"
One-off query + exitclaude -p "query"
Continue last sessionclaude -c
Resume by nameclaude --resume <name>
Pipe data incat file.txt | claude -p "analyze this"
Inside a Session
Show all commands/help
Clear context/clear
Compact (summarize)/compact
Name this session/rename <name>
Rewind to checkpoint/rewind (or Esc Esc)
View CLAUDE.md files/memory
Generate CLAUDE.md/init
Configure hooks/hooks
Switch model/model
View context usage/context
Permission Modes (Shift+Tab to cycle)
Normal ModeAsk before all actions
Auto-Accept ModeAuto-approves file edits (⏵⏵)
Plan ModeRead-only, no changes (⏸)
Start in Plan Modeclaude --permission-mode plan
Keyboard Shortcuts
Cycle permission modeShift+Tab
Stop Claude mid-actionEsc
Open rewind menuEsc Esc
Open plan in editorCtrl+G
Toggle verbose modeCtrl+O
Toggle thinkingAlt+T (Win) / Option+T (Mac)
Show shortcuts?
Built-in Skills
Simplify changed code/simplify
Large-scale parallel changes/batch <instruction>
Debug current session/debug
Load Claude API reference/claude-api
Git Worktrees
New isolated sessionclaude --worktree feature-name
Auto-name worktreeclaude --worktree
Ignore worktreesecho '.claude/worktrees/' >> .gitignore
Non-Interactive (CI / Scripts)
JSON outputclaude -p "query" --output-format json
Streaming JSONclaude -p "query" --output-format stream-json
Restrict toolsclaude -p "task" --allowedTools "Edit,Bash(git *)"
Plan Mode headlessclaude --permission-mode plan -p "analyze"
Useful Prompt Patterns
Deep reasoning"ultrathink: <complex problem>"
Reference a file"explain @src/utils/auth.ts"
Ask Claude to verify"...run tests and fix any failures"
Delegate research"use a subagent to investigate..."
Ask with interview"interview me about this feature using AskUserQuestion"
